title: Grayson Rodriguez 2024 Topps Series 1 Future Stars #111 Baltimore Orioles
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This sports trading card features Grayson Rodriguez, a promising player for the Baltimore Orioles in Major League Baseball. The card is part of the 2024 Topps Series 1 Baseball set and is numbered 111 in the sequence. It is a Future Stars card, which is a highly coveted item for collectors.

The card is manufactured by Topps and is not autographed or vintage. It is a great addition to any baseball card collection and is sure to impress fans of the Baltimore Orioles. Get your hands on this card today and add it to your sports trading card collection!
